Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the Chase. The players and umpires are making their way out in the middle. Chamari Athapaththu and Harshitha Madavi walk out to open for Sri Lanka Women while Jahanara Alam will start with the ball for Bangladesh Women. Here we go...
…THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, the target is 127. Will Sri Lanka Women chase this down and make it two wins out of two to start the tournament? Or will Bangladesh Women be able to defend a low score? The Sri Lankan reply coming up shortly. Stay tuned!

As for Sri Lanka Women, Oshadi Ranasinghe was impressive with 3 for 23 in her spell. Skipper Chamari Athapaththu chipped in with 2 wickets and Inoka Ranaweera capped off with a wicket to round off an excellent bowling effort by the Lankan lions.

A terrific comeback by Sri Lanka Women as they have restricted Bangladesh Women to 126 for 8 in their 20 overs. Opting the bat first, Bangladesh Women got off to a flying start courtesy of Shamima Sultana and Sobhana Mostary after losing the other opener Murshida Khatun for a duck. Sultana and Mostary added 28 for the 2nd wicket. Sultana was dismissed for a quick fire 20 off 13. Nigar Sultana came in got going quickly. She added 35 for the 3rd wicket with Mostary as Bangladesh were going nicely at the 10-over mark. The wickets kept falling in at regular intervals after the 15th over mark and Bangladesh scampered their way to over 126.

FOUR BYES! Extras to end the innings and four of them! This is flighted full and around off stump by Chamari Athapaththu. Jahanara Alam looks for the sweep but misses and the ball turns in a bit, eluding the keeper and trickles away into the fence. Bangladesh Women finish with 126/8 on the board!
A fraction shorter and this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! A loopy ball, well outside the off stump and it is left alone by Salma Khatun.
Direct hit would have done it! Shorter and around off, this is punched away to extra cover for a single. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Jahanara Alam is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is nicely tossed up by Chamari Athapaththu on a shorter length and around middle. Nahida Akter comes down the track and looks to swing across the line but ends up getting a top edge over the keeper's head. The fielders from short third man and short fine leg run toward the ball but it is Oshadi Ranasinghe from short fine leg who gets across first and takes the catch. That could have been a nasty collision.
Commentary.Howout: c Oshadi Ranasinghe b Chamari Athapaththu

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one, Salma Khatun charges down the track and heaves it through wide mid on for one.
Short and around off, this is pulled down to long on for a single.

DROPPED! Kavisha Dilhari puts one down! Oshadi Ranasinghe tosses it up on leg stump, Salma Khatun clears the front leg and slog-sweeps it toward deep mid-wicket. Kavisha Dilhari runs in from the deep and ends up spilling a simple chance. They pick up a couple of runs.
Flatter againa on middle and leg, Nahida Akter nudges it in front of mid-wicket for a quick single.
Back to over the wicket and bowls a flatter one outside off, Nahida Akter looks to cut but misses.
Floated up from around the wicket and angled well across the off stump, Nahida Akter hits it straight to mid off.
And again! Shorter one around off, Nahida Akter wrists it through mid-wicket for a brace.
This is slower and shorter around off, Nahida Akter works it off the back foot in front of mid-wicket and they race back for the second.
Good running! This is tossed up around off, Nahida Akter pushes it with soft hands in front of covers and gets across for a quick single.
Drifted onto the leg stump, Salma Khatun heaves it through mid-wicket for one.
Cheeky! Floated up full and around off, Salma Khatun goes for the reverse paddle and gets it fine off the flip side of the bat. They get a couple of runs.
Slower through the air and around off, Nahida Akter defends it on the off side and scampers through for the single.
Flighted delivery outside off, this is pushed away onto the off side.
Nahida Akter walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Throwing her wicket away! Inoka Ranaweera floats this one up full and outside off, inviting the big shot. Shorna Akter looks to drag and heave this one across the line but ends up slicing it around the cover region. Kavisha Dilhari there takes a simple catch and Bangladesh Women lose their 7th wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Kavisha Dilhari b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Inoka Ranaweera (3-0-13-0) comes in to bowl her final over.
Short again around middle, Salma Khatun rocks back and pulls it toward deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
This is on middle and leg, Shorna Akter flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter one on the stumps, blocked out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, my! What was Ritu Moni looking at? That is a total lapse in concentration. Chamari Athapaththu bowls it full and outside off. Moni comes forward and pushes it to point for a quick run. Sugandika Kumari there attacks the ball and throws it at the bowler's end. Moni just before reaching the crease turns her head back and Chamari Athapaththu jumps out of the way as the throw hits the stumps at the bowler's end and Moni has to walk back.
Salma Khatun walks out to bat at number 8.
WIDE! This is dragged down well down the leg side.
Quicker one, full and on leg, Shorna Akter shuffles across and works it past short fine leg for one.
Chamari Athapaththu comes back on and starts off with a shorter one around off. Ritu Moni pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter on middle and leg, worked away past square leg by Shorna Akter for a couple of runs.
Flatter and around off, pushed away toward cover for one.
Ritu Moni is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! A double-strike from Oshadi Ranasinghe and Bangladesh Women lose both the set batters. Oshadi sees Lata Mondal advancing down the track and shortens the length and also pushes it wider of the off stump. Mondal gets completely beaten in the flight and ends up running past the ball. Anushka Sanjeewani behind the sticks whips off the bails and Mondal is miles out.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Around middle, knocked down to long on for one.
Shorna Akter is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder! Oshadi Ranasinghe tosses it up full and around middle. Nigar Sultana gets a bit low and goes for the slog-sweep. Sultana gets a good connection on it but hits it straight down the throat of Harshitha Madavi at deep mid-wicket. She makes no mistake and Oshadi Ranasinghe picks up the big wicket of Nigar Sultana.
Commentary.Howout: c Harshitha Madavi b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Slower and shorter around leg, Lata Mondal stays on the back foot and nudges it 'round the corner for a single.
Quicker one pushed well outside the off stump and skidding through. Nigar Sultana looks to stay back and dab it fine but misses.
Tossed up outside off, Nigar Sultana steps out again and hits it over the cover region for a couple of runs.
This is fired in very full and wide, Sultana steps out and slaps it straight to cover-point.
Flatter again on off, Mondal bunts it out on the off side for a quick single.
Bowled flatter and quicker outside off, Lata Mondal looks to cut but misses.
Should have been put away! A juicy full toss on middle and leg, Nigar Sultana only mnages to sweep it toward deep backward square leg for a run.
Very full around middle and leg, Nigar Sultana charges down the track and slogs it over mid-wicket for a single.
Good length around middle, Sultana blocks it out.
Full and outside off, shaping away, Mondal jams it out on the off side for just another singles. The boundaries have completely dried up here for Bangladesh Women.
Full again and outside off, this is driven square toward deep cover for one.
Full and angled into middle, Nigar Sultana solidly blocks it out.
A slingy delivery, pitched up around off, Lata Mondal drives it uppishly toward the cover region for a single.
Ama Kanchana (1-0-8-0) is back into the attack.
Around middle and leg, this is worked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Drags the length back and bowls it around off, Nigar Sultana eases it off the back foot through covers for a single.
This is a bit quicker and fuller around middle, Sultana blocks it out.
Slides one into middle, Mondal plays it with soft hands onto the leg side for yet another single.
Good running! Floats it up around off, Nigar Sultana pushes it off the front foot toward cover and gets across to the other end.
Flighted delivery outside off, Lata Mondal steps out and drives it along the turf to deep cover for one.
Tosses it up now on middle, Nigar Sultana slog-sweeps it toward deep mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles a bit and they race back for the second. Excellent running.
Flatter one on middle and leg, this is worked away through wide mid on for one more.
This is down the leg and Nigar Sultana sweeps it toward fine leg for a single.
Flatter one on the pads, Nigar Sultana nudges it toward short fine leg.
Floated up on middle and leg, tucked away to mid-wicket.
This is tossed up full and on off, Nigar Sultana pushes it to the right of the bowler Chamari Athapaththu who dives and makes the stop.
Full and on the stumps, flicked away through mid-wicket for one.
Beaten! Nagging length, flatter trajectory and quicker as well outside off. Nigar Sultana looks to guide it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
WIDE! Full and sliding well down the leg side. Nigar Sultana misses the sweep and the keeper fails to collect the ball as well.
Shorter and around off, Lata Mondal goes on the back foot and eases it out on the off side for a single.
A low full toss, sliding into off stump, Nigar Sultana pushes it down to long on for one.
Quicker one, on a full length and outside off, Nigar Sultana has a little dab at it but misses.
This is full and outside off, Lata Mondal works it away well in front of mid-wicket for a single.
A yorker length delivery on the stumps. Lata Mondal digs it out and works it to mid-wicket region to get off the mark with a single.

Drinks break! Just as Bangladesh Women lose their third wicket, the umpires call for drinks. We are just one ball away from the halfway stage in this innings and it has been a pretty even contest thus far. Bangladesh Women have got away a few boundaries that has kept the scoring rate good. Sri Lanka Women have been a bit wayward with their line and lengths but have been able to pick up wickets and will look to pick up a couple more in order to stem the flow of runs here. Also, Lata Mondal is the new batter in.

OUT! GONE! CLEANED UP! Flatter one around off and this one turns in. Sobhana Mostary plays the wrong line and the ball goes through the gap and takes the timber. Chamari Athapaththu strikes as Sobhana Mostary walks out after playing a handy knock of 29.
Very full and outside off. Sobhana Mostary goes for the heave and misses. A stifled appeal but turned down.
WIDE! Flatter and drifting down the leg.
Flat and on the off stump. Nigar Sultana goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up outside off. Nigar Sultana dabs it to point.
Flatter and just outside off. Sobhana Mostary pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Full and down the leg. Sobhana Mostary sweeps it to a short fine leg and scampers for a quick single. A slight mix-up in the middle but both the batters are comfortably in.
Full and outside off. Sobhana Mostary edges it to shirt third fielder along the carpet.
Full and turns away after pitching. Sobhana Mostary prods forward and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on the pads. Nigar Sultana sweeps it to fine leg for one.
Full and on the stumps. Nigar Sultana defends it back at the bowler.
Full and outside off. Nigar Sultana squeezes it through the backward point region for a couple.
Tossed up on the stumps. Nigar Sultana chips it into the onside and takes a quick single.
Short and around off. Sobhana Mostary goes back and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for one.
Flatter and turned away to short fine leg region for one.
Turns in on the pads. Nigar Sultana works it to deep square leg region for a couple.
Tossed and down the leg. The fourth wide of the over. Nigar Sultana leaves it alone.
Turning down the leg again. Nigar Sultana goes for the pull and misses. WIDE!
Drifting down the leg. Nigar Sultana pulls it away past the short fine leg toward fine leg region for a couple.
Tad short on off. Sobhana Mostary goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Wide again. Slower and sliding down the leg.
Kavisha Dilhari starts off with a drifter down the leg. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Kavisha Dilhari to bowl for the first time in this game.
Full and on the middle and leg. Sobhana Mostary turns it away to short fine leg for one.
Tossed up outside off. Sobhana Mostary cuts it to the backward point fielder.
Flatter and outside off. Nigar Sultana goes back and pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tad short and on the stumps. Sobhana Mostary hangs back and tucks it to square leg for one.
Tossed up around off. Sobhana Mostary drops it to the onside.
Flatter and outside off. Nigar Sultana goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Inoka Ranaweera comes into the attack now.
Full and outside off. Sobhana Mostary drives it to the extra cover fielder.
FOUR! Full and outside off. Sobhana Mostary throws her hand at it and lofts it over the backward point fielder as the ball races through the turf for a boundary.
Short ball angling into the batter. Sobhana Mostary goes for the pull and misses it.
Full and just outside off. Sobhana Mostary drives it to covers.
Short of a length outside off. Sobhana Mostary looks to cut and misses.
FOUR! Full and just outside off. Sobhana Mostary lofts it wide of the mid-off fielder and hits it powerfully down the ground for four.
Fuller outside off. Nigar Sultana pushes it to covers.
Length ball just outside off. Nigar Sultana guides it nicely in the gap between the backward point and the short third as the ball runs away past the rope for four.
Nigar Sultana is the new batter.

OUT! GONE! CAUGHT! Short and outside off. Shamima Sultana looks to cut and gets an under edge through to the keeper Anushka Sanjeewani who takes it nicely down to her right. Bangladesh Women lose their second as Shamima Sultana walks back for 20.
Commentary.Howout: c Anushka Sanjeewani b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off. Sobhana Mostary slogs sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on the stumps. Sobhana Mostary sweeps it to Vishmi Gunaratne at the backward square leg who makes a good diving stop to her right.
Flatter, and around off. Sobhana Mostary tucks it to square leg.
Back of a length just outside off. Shamima Sultana lofts it just over the mid on fielder and collects two to end the over.
FOUR! SMOKED! Length delivery outside off. Shamima Sultana goes to the onside and clubs it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Very full and just outside off. Sobhana Mostary squeezes it to the third man for one.
Good length delivery shaping away again. Sobhana Mostary looks to run it down and misses.
Full and shaping away outside off. Sobhana Mostary drives and gets beaten by the swing.
Full and outside off. Shamima Sultana drives it through the cover-point region for one.
Flatter and sikds just outside off. Sobhana Mostary misses out on the cut short.

Opportunity missed by Sri Lanka Women! Sobhana Mostary tucks the shortish delivery away to square leg and looks for the single. She is sent back and is struggling to get back. Vishmi Gunaratne at square leg picks up the ball and balloons the under-arm throw over the keeper and Mostary is able to get back in.

FOUR! Third one in the over. Hat-trick of boundaries. Again bowls it short and offers plenty of width and Sobhana Mostary isn't missing out. She frees her arms and cuts it hard past the point for the third boundary of the over.
FOUR! BANG! Short again and outside off, Sobhana Mostary cuts it nicely in the gap between point and short third for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Short and outside off. Sobhana Mostary goes back and cuts it uppishly over the point fielder as the ball races to the fence for four.
An arm ball from Kumari and Mostary is hurried by the pace as she toe-ends the cut towards the lone slip fielder.
Short and wide outside the tramline. Wide signaled by the umpire as Mostary misses out on the cut shot.
Sugandika Kumari comes into the attack now.
Turning in on the pads, Sobhana Mostary nudges it in the leg side and gets off the mark with a single.
Short and turns into the batter, Sobhana Mostary pushes it to point.
Fuller delivery on leg, and Shamima Sultana flicks it in the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! BANG! Ranasinghe drops it short outside off, and Sultana rocks back and cuts it hard past the point fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up on the stumps, Sultana sweeps it but finds the square leg.
Sobhana Mostary is in at number 3.

OUT! RUN-OUT! Tosses it up outside off. Murshida Khatun looks to push through covers and gets an inside edge as the ball rolls away to a short fine leg. Inoka Ranaweera at short fine leg picks it up and gets a direct hit at the non-striker's end as Murshida Khatun attempts the run and she is caught well short of her crease. Poor running and Bangladesh Women lose their first one early.

Is that a run-out? Sri Lanka Women seem pretty confident. The throw from the short fine leg region is fired at the bowler's end by Inoka Ranaweera and the direct hit is found. The replays show that Murshida Khatun is short of her crease and OUT is the signal on the big screen.
Oshadi Ranasinghe to operate from the other end.
FOUR! Tad shortish length outside off. Shamima Sultana connects this time and cuts it though the backward point region for a boundary.
Length ball angling outside off. Shamima Sultana chases wide to cut it away but misses.
Back of a length on the 6th stump line. Shamima Sultana looks to cut and misses.
FOUR! Shamima Sultana and Bangladesh Women are up and running! Short and wide again, Shamima rocks back and slaps it away in front of point for a boundary.
Play and a miss! This is shorter and outside off, slinging away from the right-hander. Shamima Sultana looks to thrash it away but is well beaten.
Achini Kulasuriya starts off with a back-of-length ball outside off. Shamima Sultana undercuts it to first slip on a bounce.

Done with the pre-game formalities and it is now time to play! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of Sri Lanka Women. Shamima Sultana and Murshida Khatun are the openers for Bangladesh Women. Achini Kulasuriya has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are just a few minutes away from the start of play but first, the two sets of players will line up for their respective national anthems. We start with the national anthem of Sri Lanka Women followed by that of Bangladesh Women.

Sri Lanka Women (Unchanged XI) - Harshitha Madavi, Chamari Athapaththu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Nilakshi de Silva, Ama Kanchana, Kavisha Dilhari, Oshadi Ranasinghe, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera and Achini Kulasuriya.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Murshida Khatun, Shamima Sultana (WK), Sobhana Mostary, Nigar Sultana (C), Shorna Akter (On debut), Ritu Moni, Lata Mondal, Nahida Akter, Marufa Akter, Salma Khatun and Jahanara Alam.
TOSS - The flip of the coin lands in favour of Bangladesh Women and they will BAT first.

As the wait for ths toss continues here, in the first game of Super Sunday where India Women were going up against arch-rivals Pakistan Women at the very same venue has now concluded. Needing 150 to win, India Women won the game by 7 wickets with 6 balls to spare thanks to a flurry of late boundaries from Jemimah Rodrigues and Richa Ghosh. This is also the second-highest run chase in Women's T20 World Cup history.

It is time for the Match 5 of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup as Bangladesh Women take on the Sri Lanka Women. Bangladesh Women and Sri Lanka Women are in Group A alongside New Zealand Women, the hosts South Africa Women, and defending Champions Australia Women. Both teams ended their campaign in the first round itself in the previous tournaments and will be eager to go ahead to the knockouts this year. Sri Lanka Women have started their campaign on a high, and have defeated the hosts   South Africa and will look to win this match to get confidence and momentum ahead. It was a tight game and they won by a margin of just three runs. Chamari Athapaththu lead the batting line-up with 68 runs off 50 balls and Vishmi Gunaratne gave good support with 35 runs at the other end. Their bowlers restricted the opposition to 126 for 9 and won it by 3 runs. On the other hand, Bangladesh batters scored below-par totals of 101/7 & 131/8 in their 2 warm matches. Their players will need to bring their best performance to post a good total against Sri Lanka Women. Which side will come out on top? We shall find out together.
